description: Chips help people enter information, make selections, filter content, or trigger actions.

tags.devx:
- `editable` relies on contentEditable; label should be a string.
- Use `selected` with `onSelectedChange` for controlled selection, or
  `defaultSelected` for uncontrolled selection.
tags.a11y:
- Uses `aria-pressed` only in selection mode.
- Disabled links lose their navigation target and tab stop.
tags.limitations: - Edit mode starts after a 1s focus delay (no prop to customize).

label.name: label
label.description: The label is the text that is displayed on the chip.

className.name: className
className.description: Root classes (string), static element classes (object), or state-aware element classes (function).

disabled.name: disabled
disabled.description: Disables the chip if set to true.

draggable.name: draggable
draggable.description: Enable native drag and drop on the chip.

onChange.name: onChange
onChange.description: Fires whenever the editable label changes.

transition.name: transition
transition.description:
Motion timing for the selection colour change. Defaults to 0.3s.

It lived only on the React adapter, so the Angular chip's selection
snapped where React's faded.

variant.name: variant
variant.description: The chip variant determines the style.

icon.name: icon
icon.description: An optional icon to display in the chip.

defaultSelected.name: defaultSelected
defaultSelected.description: Initial selected state when the chip is uncontrolled.

onSelectedChange.name: onSelectedChange
onSelectedChange.description: Notifies selection requests in controlled and uncontrolled modes.

editable.name: editable
editable.description: Enables inline label editing, used by `Chips` in input mode.

editing.name: editing
editing.description: Controlled edition state (the resolved value lives in `states.isEditing`).

onEditStart.name: onEditStart
onEditStart.description: Requests editing, for example after a double-click, Enter, or F2.

onEditCommit.name: onEditCommit
onEditCommit.description: Commits editing with the normalized label.

onEditCancel.name: onEditCancel
onEditCancel.description: Cancels editing and restores the previous label.

tags.devx: Bind `selected` and `selectedChange` for controlled selection, or initialize with `defaultSelected`.
tags.a11y: Uses a native button or link and exposes `aria-pressed` only in selection mode. Backspace and Delete remove a removable chip.
tags.limitations:
- The delayed edit-on-focus behavior remains specific to the React adapter.
- `[class.x]` and `[ngClass]` bind to the `display: contents` host and have no visible effect; use `class`, `[class]`, or `classes`.
